text:
maya: Heads-up — CI perf regression on small-batch p95 after we pushed CUDA 12.9p1 + Triton 2.5.3 to nightly. p95 ~2.3x on A100 for seq <= 64.
liam: saw CI job 4821 fail, reproducer link: https://ci.internal/redwood/4821 — failing perf test is `smallseq-throughput-p95`.
infra-bot: [CI] job 4821 finished — perf delta: +130% p95 (regression).
devon: starting bisect now. initial hypothesis: kernel selector flipped to a new matmul variant for small seqs.
brian: uploaded nsight timeline and kernel list: https://s3.internal/nsi/1719876543/timeline.png — the new kernel is `matmul_small_v2`.
maya: repro command (local): `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python perf/bench.py --model llama-small --seq 32 --batch 4 --triton-version 2.5.3` — yields same tail spikes.
liam: quick `nvprof` shows longer stall gaps between kernels, and more L2 miss stalls during matmul_small_v2.
devon: bisect narrowed to change in Triton autotune table + driver 12.9p1 scheduler tweak. On A100, matmul_small_v2 wins in some heuristics but performs worse on our batched smallseq path.
sre-oncall: noticed KV prefetch thread emits bursts that line up with the spikes — prefetch memcpy followed by matmul_small_v2 seems to amplify tail.
devon: local test: disabling KV prefetch reduces p95 by ~40% on repro. so interaction between prefetch timing + new kernel variant likely root cause.
maya: options: (1) revert CUDA/Triton bump in nightly, (2) force kernel selector to prefer legacy matmul for seq <= 64 on A100, (3) tune KV prefetch timing. Which is least risky for canary? @prod-ops?
liam: I pushed a tiny selector override patch we can canary:
```
autotune:
  prefer_kernel_for:
    - kernel: "matmul_small_v1"
      conditions:
        max_seq_len: 64
        gpu_family: "A100"
```
liam: PR https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/813 (selector-override). low-risk, limited scope.
brian: opened rollback PR for the triton bump as a fallback: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/814 — revert triton->2.5.3.
sre-oncall: rollout is blocked until perf gate passes and infra approval. marking as rollout-blocker. :warning:
devon: will run canary with selector-override on a few racks and run the smallseq perf suite. ETA ~90m.
infra-bot: Issue created: PERF-1723 "small-batch p95 spike after cuda12.9p1 + triton2.5.3" assigned to devon.
maya: also please add a CI microbenchmark that runs seq 16/32/64 on A100 after upgrades — catch this earlier.
liam: adding bench to nightly perf smoke in a follow-up PR.
devon: will post canary results in this thread when done.
brian: thanks for quick triage everyone.
maya: thanks — tagging @eng-oncall to monitor rollout. :thumbsup:
__notes: Single-thread Slack export: root message + replies in chronological order. Messages are short, with code blocks, links, emoji, and bot notifications.
